title: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
solution_py:
import html def render_comment(username: str, comment: str) -> str: """ Context-aware output encoding: each user value is HTML-encoded before it is placed into the template, so user input is always rendered as text and can never be parsed as markup. The structural tags are the app's own HTML. """ safe_user = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_comment = html.escape(comment, quote=True) return '
' + safe_user + ": " + safe_comment + "
"
